rows.subtopic: Bystander effect and diffusion of responsibility
rows.description: A young adult regrets having watched and done nothing. Instead of hiding, they use the shame to decide how to act next time and to apologise to the person affected.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 23–26
related mind states: shame, guilt, regret

rows.subtopic: Bystander effect and diffusion of responsibility
rows.description: A commuter sees someone collapse or a woman harassed, and the crowd keeps walking. Pluralistic ignorance makes each person read the others' inaction as proof it is not serious.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.subtopic: Bystander effect and diffusion of responsibility
rows.description: An adult in an emergency points at one person and says you, call an ambulance, you, bring water. Naming someone breaks the diffusion of responsibility and gets action moving.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22
possibly related concept (heuristic): Moral disengagement: displacing and diffusing responsibility

rows.description: A child lets others do most of the poster or project because their own effort will not be noticed. The group's shared credit makes doing less feel safe.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A teacher or child assigns each member a named part and shows who did what. Visible individual accountability shrinks loafing without needing punishment.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A teenager does the minimum in a group project, assuming the diligent ones will finish it. They feel a little guilty but also clever, and rarely admit it.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A conscientious student ends up doing most of a shared task and grows resentful. They fear complaining will look bossy, so anger builds quietly.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: anger, fear, resentment

rows.description: Team members see a friend not pulling their weight and stay silent to protect the relationship. The unfairness slowly damages the whole team's trust.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 23–26

rows.subtype: Feeling anonymous in a large team [Actor]
rows.description: A student in a big group feels their contribution does not matter or cannot be traced, so effort drops. The same student works hard when their part is visible.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 23–26

rows.description: A team member asks a coasting teammate what is going on, in private, before escalating. Sometimes there is a hidden reason such as illness or confusion, and sometimes it is plain avoidance.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 23–26
